digest.component_or_area: plan-review pass-1 and batch runner usage aggregation
propositions: Pass-1 call usage is discarded by pass1_chunk/pass1_container/pass1_isf (returning findings lists only) instead of being threaded through the call chain to accumulate in BatchRunResult outputs
Per-criterion request counts are extracted but never persisted, blocking data-driven criterion demotion decisions
Ladder retry attempts and multi-criterion chunk token attribution must be recorded with criteria lists to enable per-criterion aggregation and equal division across covered criteria
The usage aggregation protocol must handle raising attempts (contributing nothing) and checkpoint-served chunks (contributing nothing) while recording all completed attempts

All external callers of pass functions and run_focused_finder across eval_solver, criterion_preview, and fidelity_spot_eval must be updated atomically to unpack the new (findings/text, usage) return pairs
